## #2 — Eureka! — 2007-02-10
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/1320/post-8301>

Hi,
1. Drag the script into the polygonobj folder in the scripts folder.

2: Restart Cheetah.

3: Go to Tools>Scripts>Polygon. Open the script.

4: Drag the box (or what ever polygon you want to effect) into the script.

5: Make the settings on the script what you want.

6: Click update.

I hope this answered your question.

Thanks,
Greg
